_readme: The lineup. Channel numbers are what you punch into the box. Each channel plays from named pools by daypart (days: 0=Sun..6=Sat, local time); gaps between dayparts are off-air (test pattern). Pools list YouTube sources: playlist/channel/video URLs or ytsearchN:query. Every source has a tier: legit (official uploader), wild (unofficial), filler (commercials, bumpers). Tiers in `include` are built for every channel; a channel marked "wild": true also builds the wild sources of its pools, but only while the top-level "wild" master switch is on: flip it to false and rebuild, and every unofficial upload leaves the catalog at once. Wild sources are admitted only after tools/embed_check.js has watched them play (data/embeddable.json). Holiday dayparts ("holiday": MM-DD | easter | thanksgiving) are a soft mix weighted toward whatever is coming up inside the channel's forward window (days, default 90); off season the channel plays a random smattering of all of them. Rebuild with: python3 tools/build_catalog.py Commercials: shows start on the hour or half hour; the padding to the next boundary is commercials, spread as one or two act breaks inside the show (each up to breakSeconds, 150) with the rest after the credits; long broadcasts break about every 15 min. Block (music) channels break every breakEvery seconds between songs. breakEvery 0 on a channel = no commercials.

pledge._: The pledge drive (js/pledge.js). enabled=false switches off the slate, the guide line and the TV Week notice at once. url/label are the tip jar; minutes watched or channel changes trigger the slate at the next act break, then not again for cooldownDays. bulletinShare 4 = one guide bulletin in four.

channels.name: COUNTRY
channels._note: Videos all day; Live from Austin at 9. Legit-only music; the wild door is for the ACL episodes.

channels.name: SCIENCE
channels._note: Period science and the animal kingdom. Wild Kingdom, Wild America, Caltech, the film archives and The Computer Chronicles are legit; Cosmos, NOVA, Cousteau, Connections and the specials come through the wild door.

channels.name: PUBLIC ACCESS
channels._note: Era-appropriate low-quality television. No commercials (public access never had any). Overnight and mornings are the Community Bulletin Board, a generated text slate (js/slates.js); the rest is the archives.

channels.name: WEATHER
channels._note: Weather Scan: a generated forecast slate (js/slates.js) from the National Weather Service's open API. Ten fixed cities on a clock, Minneapolis most; the viewer's location is never asked for.

channels.name: GOLF
channels._note: Vintage golf, the Masters one voice among several. Wild door open for the Skins Games, Shell's and the instructional tapes.

channels.name: PREMIUM
channels._note: Scrambled pay TV. No video source; drawn on a canvas. The schedule of titles is generated in js/scramble.js.

golf._note: Vintage golf. The Masters is one voice, not the whole channel. Legit: USGA, The R&A, PGA TOUR (which posts the 1983 Skins Game and the 1962 Shell's episodes itself), Ryder Cup, LPGA. Wild: the Skins Games, Shell's Wonderful World of Golf, and the instructional VHS tapes that filled Sunday mornings. Years through 1992 only.

music-country._note: 80s country, legit only: the Nashville labels posted their video archives. Curated 80s playlists restricted to official uploaders, plus every artist's own channel; the artist channels carry 90s and modern videos too, so tools/prune_years.py drops anything outside yearRange (or without a year) after enrich_music runs. Rebuild order: music-country-core, then music-country, then enrich_music.py (or mb_years.py when YouTube is throttling per-video fetches), then prune_years.py music-country --keep-from music-country-core.
